description: Full metadata for one item: filename, taken time and timezone offset, file size, dimensions, photo/video and duration, camera make/model/aperture/ISO/exposure when present, face count and named people, favorite flag, location (latitude/longitude from the file's GPS plus Google's place name; null when the item has none), plus thumbnail and original download URLs (those need the session: use download_media for bytes).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email whose Google Photos library to use (e.g. the one at /u/1/). Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user; do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: get_media
